form_factor.value: handheld and desktop terminal following the latest two uploaded reference images: low horizontal base, raised rear sloping screen housing, exposed flat front deck; not a single shallow wedge

value.implementation: Pi native USB-A, no baseboard socket, hub or extension cable

usb_c_role.value: charging and power input only; peripherals use USB-A

primary_use.value: Linux terminal, SSH and portable tools

local_input.value: Prototype baseboard provides power, display and a user-replaceable front-deck GPIO module interface; no fixed navigation/confirm/back button bank; text and navigation via external keyboard on Pi native USB

battery_runtime_test.value: 20–25 C; no added illumination or USB-powered peripherals; Wi-Fi connected; terminal open with a low-traffic SSH session and periodic text updates. Separately characterize runtime with a wired USB keyboard; do not claim the baseline covers it.

battery_architecture.value: Internal factory-protected 1S Li-ion pack, nominal 3.7V/3300mAh, user-supplied against the baseboard battery interface specification; not an arbitrary bare cell.

value: no reboot on external power insertion or removal
controlled Linux shutdown before battery cutoff

appearance.value: orange raised screen housing with dark inset bezel on an ivory low horizontal base; front horizontal deck; no inferred hidden functions

screen_mount.value: fixed-angle raised rear screen housing on horizontal base; no hinge

value.status: provisional corrected styling envelope, not verified hardware fit

prototype_process.value: FDM enclosure; STEP CAD handoff; printing preparation separately scoped

display_interface.value: 10-terminal serial interface with COM inversion; not HDMI; GPIO electrical compatibility and power sequencing require implementation verification

local_button_default.value: One controlled power/shutdown button retained as a power-management control, not a navigation interface

battery_runtime_policy.value: No fixed minimum runtime; evaluate and report actual runtime for selected hardware and use conditions rather than requiring two hours.

compute_supply_model.value: User supplies Raspberry Pi; product is our custom baseboard and peripherals, not a bundled Raspberry Pi

compute_attachment.value: Simple installation of user-owned Pi4B onto our baseboard by GPIO docking and minimal mechanical fastening; no separate internal Pi power cable

supported_compute_scope.value: Initial compatibility target Raspberry Pi 4 Model B,4GB reference configuration; other Raspberry Pi models not qualified by header similarity alone

pi_usb_c_docked_use.value: Lite variant: Pi native USB-C is the sole power input and must be accessible when docked. Full variant: original interlocked cover and baseboard USB-C input remain required.

battery_supply_model.value: User will source a compatible battery; proceed with baseboard development without waiting for an agent-selected battery MPN. Battery is excluded from kit procurement.

development_order.value: CAD styling before PCB; appearance is important. Use exterior design to guide later board layout.

cad_first_scope.value: First CAD delivery is an editable exterior visual study, not final hardware fit or a printable production enclosure; preserve final electrical/assembly requirements for subsequent integration.

value.power_button: single existing control relocated to right side

screen_angle_direction.value: Reduce the steep screen slope toward the shallow red-line profile in mark.png; no exact angle specified.

external_port_location.value: All external cable interfaces on rear or sides, none on front; reserve openings for Pi native USB and RJ45.

rear: Pi 4 USB-A sockets in two stacks
value.microSD: internal service after removal of bottom and isolation of all power

screen_pod_front_rise_datum.value: Nominal sharp intersection of sloping top and foremost housing plane, measured vertically above horizontal deck, including the existing0.3mm assembly seam; rounded edge rolls below nominal.

front_module_replaceability.value: The marked front deck is a user-replaceable region for future GPIO function modules; the base product provides a removable blank and a reusable mechanical/electrical interface while preserving the display mounting and 1 mm screen-pod front rise.

front_module_service_policy.value: Power off, disconnect external input and isolate the battery before removing or connecting a front module; no live hot swap claim.

single_baseboard_integration.value: One custom baseboard integrates the Sharp display interface, user-replaceable front GPIO expansion, battery charging and Pi 4B power supply; no separate board for these functions.

variant_scope_policy.value: Active lite variant has display and 8-contact expansion only; battery, charger, MCU, Pi supply and interlock requirements apply exclusively to retained full pi_baseboard variant.

lite_supply_entry.value: Pi native USB-C powers Pi; GPIO 5V pins supply only display and module branches. Enclosure must allow Pi USB-C in lite variant.

lite_module_service.value: Cold plug only; modules powered solely by AUX_3V3, no external supply and no 5V logic. Pinout is custom, not Pi header pins 1-8.

lite_fpc_placement.value: Horizontal side-entry FPC on top of compact PCB; opening toward down/front (-Y in top view), native tail bends behind panel. Preserve bottom contacts and verify installation access.

value.intent: Taller Pi socket, lower 8pin expansion socket, horizontal FPC opening toward lower/front side.

native_tail_estimation_authorization.value: Proceed using an agent-estimated screen-tail length and allow reasonable assembly clearance rather than waiting for a physical measurement.

value.datum: Glass exit edge to tail tip measured along tail; includes stiffener and inserted length.

value.note: 0.5mm is additional free-space clearance, not cable-length extension. Manufacturer bend limits retained. Slot stop and pin1 still require evidence.

lite_baseboard_attachment.value: Raise the compact PCB toward the screen and fasten it to the upper enclosure; its support must not rely on the bottom cover or removable front module blank.
